priorityList: Pre-cast Arcane Intellect and Mirror Image before combat.
Activate Combustion at the end of a Frostfire Bolt or Pyroblast cast when it is ready.
Use Trinkets, Potions, and Racials while Combustion is active, ideally when more than 6 seconds remain.
Cast Meteor while Combustion is active or as a lead-in when Combustion is about to become ready.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Pyroblast.
Use Fire Blast off-GCD while casting to convert Heating Up into a Hot Streak.
Do not use Fire Blast if you already have a Hot Streak active or have a crit-guaranteed spell in flight.
Use Scorch whenever Heat Shimmer is active.
Use Scorch as your filler instead of Frostfire Bolt if the target is below 30% health and you have the Scald talent.
During Combustion, cast Pyroclasm-empowered Pyroblasts only if the cast will finish before Combustion expires.
Outside of Combustion, spend Pyroclasm stacks on Pyroblast if you reach 2 stacks or if the Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds.
Use Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler spell outside of the target's execute range.
